description: This source file contains unit tests for the TalkDirectiveParser component of the OpenClawKit project. It verifies parsing of directive strings and handling of various options and edge cases.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveTests
classes.description: A test suite for parsing and handling Talk directives within the OpenClawKit project.

methods.name: testParsesDirectiveAndStripsLine
methods.description: Tests parsing of a JSON directive with voice and once fields, and verifies the stripped text output.

methods.name: testIgnoresNonDirective
methods.description: Checks that non-directive text results in a nil directive and proper stripped output.

methods.name: testKeepsDirectiveLineIfNoRecognizedFields
methods.description: Verifies behavior when a directive contains unrecognized keys; ensures directive is ignored.

methods.name: testParsesExtendedOptions
methods.description: Tests parsing of extended directive options such as voice_id, model_id, rate, stability, etc.

methods.name: testSkipsLeadingEmptyLinesWhenParsingDirective
methods.description: Ensures that leading empty lines are correctly skipped before parsing directives.

methods.name: testTracksUnknownKeys
methods.description: Checks that unknown JSON keys are correctly tracked and stored.
